summary: OR Royalties Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 23, 2026, an asset portfolio briefing on producing, development and exploration royalties. Updates include first gold at Cui Cui on September 10, 2026 with commercial production expected Q4 2026 under a 1.0% NSR; imminent first gold at Amulsar and ramp-up targeted H1 2027 under gold and silver streams; CSA FY27 guidance of 28-30 kt copper; and Dalgaranga and Bralorne operational progress. No transaction, tender, or special-situation event is disclosed.
